headline: Anthropic IPO valuation expectations fall as growth trajectory slows
body: Investors are lowering their valuation expectations for Anthropic's potential IPO following signs of revenue growth deceleration at the AI safety-focused company. For healthcare AI implementations, this market uncertainty around major foundation model providers carries direct implications for enterprise adoption timelines and vendor viability assessments. Healthcare systems evaluating Claude-based clinical decision support or documentation tools should factor in potential shifts to Anthropic's product roadmap and support capacity. The broader slowdown in large language model company growth rates may actually benefit healthcare AI vendors focused on narrower, validated use cases over generalist models.
